278391199.description:
Maxell Sony RCA Blank Audio Cassette Tape Lot
8 Piece Collection
Normal Bias Type I Tapes
This lot features eight factory-sealed blank audio cassette tapes from Maxell, Sony, and RCA. These Normal Bias Type I tapes are ideal for everyday recording and general music use. As physical media sees a resurgence, these sealed tapes offer a reliable way to capture analog audio on cassette decks and portable recorders.
Items Included:
1.
Maxell UR 120 (6 Tapes)
- Normal Bias, 120 minutes, IEC Type I.
2.
Sony HF 60 (1 Tape)
- High Fidelity Normal Bias, 60 minutes, Type I.
3.
RCA Hi-Fi Stereo (1 Tape)
- Normal Bias, 90 minutes, Type I.
Condition:
All eight tapes are factory sealed in original cellophane. The plastic wrap is intact on all units. The hard plastic cases appear undamaged under the wrap. Some tapes feature original retail or thrift price stickers on the exterior plastic. Magnetic tape functionality is not guaranteed due to the age of the media.
